_notes: Vanilla 26.3 shelves, recorded by Obsidian.AssetGenerator/Java/ShelfFixtures.java (CaptureFixtures=shelves) on BlockUseFixtures' dedicated server in a flat world of air. Cases take block_use.json's inputs: blocks set around the target without updates (with their block entity's 'nbt'), a player at 'player' (x, y, z, yaw, pitch) with the case's hands, 'selected' hotbar slot and 'hotbar' slots (slot, item, count). A case's 'kind' is 'use' (the default: the hand's item used on the clicked face through ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn), 'set' ('place' set with every update), 'hopper' (the hopper at 'hopper' runs pushItemsTick once) or 'break' (the user breaks the clicked block), then the tick's block events. Every case records block_use.json's outputs with checkWrites and checkEffects, items' components in 'entities', 'userEffects' (the sounds, level events and block events sent to the acting player), 'blockEntities' (each setup block entity's saved data, as 'x,y,z snbt'), 'inventory' (with checkInventory: the 36 storage slots) and 'comparatorSignal' (the comparator at 'comparator' once its pending tick ran).
